		function parameter_skip(url) {
			var pageUrl = window.location.href;
			var urlParameter = '';
			if(pageUrl.indexOf('?') > -1){
				urlParameter = pageUrl.split('?')[1];
			}
			if(urlParameter){
				window.location.href = url + '?' + urlParameter
			}else{
				window.location.href = url;
			}
		}

		var is_mobile = isMobile();
		var is_ipad = isIpad();
		if(is_mobile && !is_ipad){
			parameter_skip('https://p5x.wanmei.com/m/news/index.html');
		}

			var docEl = doc.documentElement,resizeEvt = 'orientationchange' in window ? 'orientationchange' : 'resize',
			recalc = function(){
				var clientWidth = window.innerWidth;
				if (!clientWidth) return;
				var wid = 100 * (clientWidth / 2560);
				docEl.style.fontSize = wid + 'px';
			};
			if (!doc.addEventListener) return;
			win.addEventListener(resizeEvt, recalc, false);
			recalc();
			doc.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', recalc, false);
		})(document, window);
